ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white field across both lobes. A continuous low-intensity black border (~10-20 pixels wide) follows the entire trailing edge. A central dark pigmentation cluster is located at the median notch, extending vertically toward the peduncle. Sparse dark focal spots and linear marks are visible on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped depression with a calculated aperture of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3-10 pixels along the continuous trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curve fitted to the outer leading edges, tapering to sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark pixel clusters located at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of at least three distinct, near-horizontal low-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) on the medial-lower section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible linear rake marks on the right lobe and irregular, jagged pigmentation loss at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique, dark 'Y-shaped' pigmentation feature at the central base where the lobes converge.
